request.prompt: A brand sonic logo (audio mnemonic) for the end card of a premium Indian TV commercial, simple enough to hum after one listen. D major. Three rising notes in a short-short-long rhythm on a warm acoustic guitar pluck doubled by felt piano, with a soft bansuri flute breathing the same three notes; the long third note blooms into a warm D major chord with strings and a low piano note; short clean tail into silence. Hopeful, human, trustworthy, premium. Instrumental only. No drums.

headers.access-control-allow-methods: POST, PATCH, OPTIONS, DELETE, GET, PUT
